Several people are killed and at least 10 people are injured after the Russian corvette Merkury is struck by a Ukrainian naval drone attack while docked at the port of Benghazi, Libya. The Merkury reportedly capsizes and sinks
A Maltese-flagged ship is also struck by naval drones off the coast of Benghazi
Naval warfare in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present), Ukrainian attacks on the Russian shadow fleet
The 63rd Golden Horse Awards take place in Taipei, Taiwan, with the Hong Kong film We Are Born Good winning Best Narrative Feature

Several garment factories in Gazipur, Bangladesh declare holidays amid ongoing minimum wage protests, as clashes erupt between workers and police along the Dhaka–Mymensingh Highway, with workers throwing bricks and police firing tear gas and stun grenades while Special Response Battalion, Ansar, BGB, and Industrial Police personnel deploy to the area

Border Guard Bangladesh deploys 95 platoons across seven districts, including two battalions in Gopalganj, stepping up surveillance at key installations and industrial zones using drones and police body cameras
2026 Bangladesh garment workers protests
At least twelve people are killed and 23 others are injured in two separate road accidents in Rajasthan, India
A severe thunderstorm kills five people and injures more than 250 others in Tupanciretã, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil
A fire at a confectionery factory in Serang Regency, Banten, Indonesia, kills at least three people, leaves 36 others missing, and injures four
Three people are killed in a house fire in Trzcianka, Poland

The 2026 United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP31) in Antalya, Turkey, concludes without a final agreement after countries failed to reach consensus on fossil fuel policies. It is the longest climate summit on record
2026 United Nations Climate Change Conference

South Korean education minister Choi Kyo-jin resigns following criticism of the government's response to artificial intelligence-assisted cheating concerns surrounding the College Scholastic Ability Test. President Lee Jae Myung accepts Choi's resignation
In tennis, Carlos Alcaraz defeats Alexander Zverev in the final, 6–2, 7–6(9–7) to win his first singles title at the 2026 ATP Finals

In motorcycle racing, Spanish rider Marc Márquez of Ducati Corse secures his eighth MotoGP World Championship after finishing eighth at the Portuguese Grand Prix, equalling Giacomo Agostini's record for the most premier-class motorcycle racing world titles
